heroBadge: We are here to support your learning journey
heroSubtitle: Have questions about our 12 world languages, feedback on quizzes, suggestions for new dialects, or want to partner with us? Reach our dedicated team directly below.

faqs.question: Who receives my contact request?
faqs.answer: Your submission is dispatched immediately to both nnejieb@gmail.com and nneji.obioma@gmail.com. We also securely log the message so that no learner request is ever lost.

faqs.question: How fast can I expect a response?
faqs.answer: We review all inquiries daily and typically reply within 12 to 24 hours (Monday through Saturday). Urgent technical or account queries are prioritized.

faqs.question: Can I suggest a new world language or local dialect?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! FliksLingo is committed to promoting both widely spoken international languages (Spanish, French, Mandarin, German, Japanese) and culturally rich African languages (Yoruba, Igbo, Hausa, Nigerian Pidgin). If you want a specific language added, select "Request a New Language" in the form.

faqs.question: Can schools or universities integrate FliksLingo for students?
faqs.answer: Yes! We support classroom use, customized language modules, and group leaderboards. Contact us via the form or email us directly at nnejieb@gmail.com and nneji.obioma@gmail.com for institutional setup.

faqs.question: Is FliksLingo free for learners?
faqs.answer: Yes, all 12 languages, quizzes, culture vaults, audio pronunciation, and daily practice streaks are completely free to start!
